author: SnowSX3
body:
Oh look another topic on why MCZone was always and will forever be superior to The Avicus Network. 

Shouldn't these topics be locked? I mean, people complain and complain but they don't know how hard running a big server really is. 

As a new(ish) player, it's quite annoying seeing all these people who can't let go of the past.

How about instead of complaining we thank the staff and moderators who give up their free time to give us the entertainment that is the Avicus Network. 

Not a single staff member gets paid to do this so we owe them a ton.

We as a community need to say thank you to the staff team a lot more often.

Instead of whining and complaining, how about we give give constructive criticism on the negative things and praise the positive things. 

People will probably misinterpret that last sentence but whatever.

Thank you Avicus Staff, you truly do a fantastic job.
I just wish the rest of the community feels the same way.
